title: Benzotriazole ultraviolet stabilizers impair trophoblast function at nanomolar concentrations via GPER signaling: implications for placental health.
authors: Zhao, Ze-Pei; Zhu, Shi-Ye; Hu, Ying-Huang; Wan, Yu-Ke; Xu, Shang-Jun; Ma, Jie-Zhi; Lai, Deng-Ni; Chen, An-Wei; Yang, Yuan; Luo, Lin; Cao, Lin-Ying
one_liner_zh: 该文研究紫外线稳定剂通过GPER信号影响滋养层功能，仅用MD模拟考察配体-受体结合，不涉及蛋白质-DNA互作或TF-DNA体系，与本课题无关。
abstract: Benzotriazole ultraviolet stabilizers (BUVSs) are ubiquitous emerging contaminants with documented multifaceted toxicity. However, their potential impacts on human placental development and underlying mechanisms remain poorly understood. This study investigated the effects of three representative BUVSs (UV-P, UV-326, and UV-328) on trophoblast function via G-protein-coupled estrogen receptor (GPER) pathway. Molecular dynamics simulations revealed that UV-328 binds to GPER with higher affinity than UV-P and UV-326, which even exceeds that of the native ligand 17beta-estradiol (E2). Calcium influx assays demonstrated that all three BUVSs activated GPER signaling pathway in a concentration-dependent manner, with lowest observed effect concentrations (LOECs) of 10-100 nM. Each BUVS enhanced trophoblast proliferation-most potently by UV-328 (LOEC = 1 nM)-through GPER-mediated upregulation of Cyclin D1 and Ki-67, indicating promotion of cell cycle progression. Wound-healing and transwell assays showed that all three BUVSs promoted trophoblast migration and invasion with LOECs of 1-100 nM via GPER pathway. Furthermore, the three BUVSs opposing regulated expression between epithelial (down) and mesenchymal (up) markers and upregulated the expression of matrix metalloproteinases (MMP2/9) through activating GPER, indicating that GPER-mediated epithelial-mesenchymal transition and extracellular matrix remodeling should be key events in BUVSs-induced migration and invasion. UV-328 consistently exhibited the strongest effects on trophoblast functions, aligning with its superior GPER activation potency. Importantly, the LOECs for UV-328-induced trophoblast dysfunction fall within nanomolar ranges relevant to estimated human exposure levels. Together, these results reveal GPER-mediated mechanistic pathways through which BUVSs disrupt trophoblast function and highlight their potential risk in gestational disorders.
abstract_zh: 苯并三唑紫外线稳定剂（BUVSs）是普遍存在的新兴污染物，具有记录在案的多方面毒性。然而，它们对人类胎盘发育的潜在影响及其潜在机制仍知之甚少。本研究通过G蛋白偶联雌激素受体（GPER）途径，调查了三种代表性BUVSs（UV-P、UV-326和UV-328）对滋养层功能的影响。分子动力学模拟显示，UV-328与GPER的结合亲和力高于UV-P和UV-326，甚至超过天然配体17β-雌二醇（E2）。钙内流实验表明，所有三种BUVSs均以浓度依赖性方式激活GPER信号通路，最低观察效应浓度（LOECs）为10-100 nM。每种BUVS均增强滋养层增殖——其中UV-328作用最强（LOEC = 1 nM）——通过GPER介导的Cyclin D1和Ki-67上调，表明促进细胞周期进程。伤口愈合和transwell实验显示，所有三种BUVSs通过GPER途径促进滋养层迁移和侵袭，LOECs为1-100 nM。此外，三种BUVSs对上皮（下调）和间充质（上调）标志物之间的表达进行相反调控，并通过激活GPER上调基质金属蛋白酶（MMP2/9）的表达，表明GPER介导的上皮-间充质转化和细胞外基质重塑应是BUVSs诱导迁移和侵袭的关键事件。UV-328在滋养层功能上始终表现出最强效应，与其优越的GPER激活效力一致。重要的是，UV-328诱导滋养层功能障碍的LOECs处于与估计人类暴露水平相关的纳摩尔范围内。综合这些结果，揭示了BUVSs通过GPER介导的机制途径破坏滋养层功能，并强调其在妊娠疾病中的潜在风险。
